text:
rachel (partnerships): Quick pulse-check: draft private-offer structure for HW partners who want to resell Redwood Dedicated. Short summary below, want any red flags.
diego (sales): go for it.
rachel (partnerships): Plan: three commitment bands (Starter/Business/Enterprise) mapped to reserved GPU-month SKUs; partner gets a one-time onboarding voucher for certified SI hours; renewal protection clause that preserves unit price for one renewal if capacity is maintained; renewal taper after that.
eka (finance): voucher as invoice credit ok. Need expiry (suggest 90 days) and partial redemption allowed. Also require planId mapping for marketplace payload.
tara (solutions): console needs a partner_id tag + voucher redemption UI. Estimate 1 sprint.
sam (legal): include non-transferable credits, anti-fraud, and marketplace mechanics clause. Also add contingency: if HW supply short, we can temporarily route to Hosted API at pro-rated price.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: AWS/GCP private-offers require planId and term in the offer payload; reseller flows vary.
diego (sales): timeline: if legal/finance drafts in 1 week and console prioritized, can pilot in 5-6 weeks.
rachel (partnerships): Action items: 1) Eka: SKU mapping + voucher expiry (EOD tomorrow). 2) Sam: legal T&Cs for voucher + contingency (next Tue). 3) Tara: JIRA for partner_id + voucher UI (today). 4) Diego: confirm pilot partner (EOD).
eka (finance): ack.
sam (legal): ack.
tara (solutions): ack.
rachel (partnerships): thanks all — I'll fold into PO draft after inputs. :thumbsup:
